correctness.rationale: The hyperelliptic model y^2=x(x^3-1)(x^3-t) has seven simple roots for t!=0,1 in characteristic 13 and genus 3. The Cartier–Manin coefficient matrix c_(13i-j) from f^6 is diagonal by degrees mod 3 and equals diag(2t^4 A, BDE, 2A). Independently recomputed f^6 in GF13 and checked all three entries/factors. Four irreducible pairwise disjoint quadratics with nonsquare discriminants give exactly two rank-one/a=2 and six rank-two/a=1 parameters, and otherwise ordinary. Diagonal semilinearity yields stable Cartier rank equal to ordinary rank; inversion exchanges the corresponding roots without fixed exceptional points.
